tasks.command:
cd /mnt/e/LexiLab && .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from lexilab.config.settings import load_settings
from lexilab.context import AppContext
s=load_settings(); s.audio.enabled=False; ctx=AppContext(s)
for w in ['mitigate','predict','bank','adapt']:
 print('###',w)
 for k,vs in ctx.relations.groups(w).items():
  print(k, [(v.headword, v.target_sense or v.source_sense, v.score) for v in vs[:8]])
PY
